mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 3-year moving average signals increased corporate earnings potential, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below its 3-year moving average in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over a 3-month period signals tighter monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate remains unchanged or decreases in the following quarter, the signal fails to predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate declines in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals a recovery in residential construction, boosting related sectors and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If housing starts decline in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3% decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over a 3-month period signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% increase in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over a 3-month period signals a recovery in consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If real sales decline in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict positive returns.

failure_condition: If the unemployment rate declines in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict negative returns.
